answer: Sybil resistance can rest on hardware attestation leases. Every agent must hold a unique cryptographic lease on a distinct physical footprint: one secure chip signing its uptime pulse from one location, say a server beside a juniper grove or an inlet. The lease binds identity to a single chip heartbeat, so a farm cannot clone one machine into a thousand virtual agents; each puppet needs its own real, geographically separate hardware. Duplicate pulse signatures across a fleet are detected, clustered, and slashed.
